color.note: Honey on stone. Two themes: Comb (beeswax light) and Basalt (stone dark). There is no purple anywhere in this system, on purpose.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and editor background. Beeswax in Comb, cooled stone in Basalt.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the command palette, the active tab.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, inactive tab strip, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, tree items and quiet buttons on any surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between panes. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons, the off Toggle track; holds 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, surface-hover and honey-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholder and tree icons, on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps and counts only, on surface and surface-raised (4.5:1). Never on surface-sunken body copy.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: The brand fill: primary button, filled task cell, selected comb cell, an on Toggle, the app icon tile. A fill, not a text colour — text on it is on-honey.

tokens.name: on-honey
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a honey or pollen fill. Never white.

tokens.name: honey-text
tokens.usage: Honey as text: wikilinks, active tree item, the selected tab marker; on surface, surface-raised and honey-soft.

tokens.name: honey-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: tags, selected tree row, hovered wikilink, tip callouts. Text on it is ink or honey-text.

tokens.name: pollen
tokens.usage: ==Highlight== marks and search hits. Text on it is on-honey in both themes.

tokens.name: wax
tokens.usage: Well-linked comb cells (weight 2) and the accent cells of the EmptyState honeycomb. Decorative ground; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Large brand blocks and the stone avatar; the logo uses its own fixed stone tones. Decorative; text on it is stone-ink.

tokens.name: stone-light
tokens.usage: The lit face of a column in illustrations. Decorative only.

tokens.name: stone-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a stone block (the app icon, dark marketing bands).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour; solid, 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes. Used through the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Success and synced status, as text or icon on surface and moss-soft. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind moss text.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Danger, conflicts, destructive actions; as text or icon on surface and ember-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ember text; the warning callout.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on an ember fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Informational callouts and external links (a link that leaves the hive); on surface and sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sky text; the info callout.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Internal wikilinks — an alias of honey-text so a theme that moves honey moves links.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the command palette and modals.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque: chunky, a little irregular, like cut stone. Headings and marketing only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing and onboarding headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A note's title (the H1 at the top of the editor).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: H2 inside notes; dialog and settings section titles.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk for every piece of chrome: sidebar, tabs, buttons, menus.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tree items, tabs, menu rows.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Active tree item, hive name, dialog buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in the sidebar and panels. Uppercase is applied in CSS, written in sentence case.

groups.name: Writing
groups.note: Literata for the words people write. Notes read like a book, not a terminal.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Basalt splits into columns because it shrinks as it cools, and six sides is the cheapest way to share the strain.
styles.usage: Note body text in the editor and reading view.

styles.name: prose-small
styles.usage: HoverPreview excerpts, callout and empty-state bodies, search result excerpts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, raw markdown in source mode, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between tree rows' icon and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and callout padding; sidebar gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between note blocks and dialog sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Editor side padding at narrow widths.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Editor top padding; between page-level sections.

radius.note: Stone is fractured, not rounded. Small radii on rectangles; no pills — where another system would reach for a pill, Basalt uses a hexagon (see shape).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd keys, highlight marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tree rows, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, menus, the command palette.

shape.note: The hexagon is Basalt's round. Apply with clip-path: var(--hex-flat). A regular hexagon is 1.1547 times as wide as it is tall (flat) or tall as it is wide (pointy).

tokens.name: hex-flat
tokens.usage: Flat-top hexagon: comb cells, the empty-state pattern. Width = height × 1.1547.

tokens.name: hex-pointy
tokens.usage: Pointy-top hexagon: avatars, hive badges, task cells, icon wells. Height = width × 1.1547.

tokens.name: hex-chip
tokens.usage: Hex-ended chip, Basalt's pill: tags and count badges. Ends are 9px deep for a 22px-tall chip.

shadow.note: Basalt is matte. Shadows are short and warm; nothing glows, nothing is glossy.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, the active tab, inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The command palette, menus, hover previews, toasts — anything floating.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on rectangles: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of solid focus. Hex-clipped controls can't show it (clip-path cuts shadows): they take a 2px solid focus outline on an unclipped wrapper instead.

timing.note: Unhurried. Things settle, they don't bounce.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, palettes, toasts arriving, a task cell filling, a toggle sliding.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Every transition. No springs, no overshoot.
